description: Find a verified work email by full name + company domain (or website URL — TryKitt extracts the domain), via TryKitt.ai. Example: trykitt_find_email({ full_name: "Patrick Collison", domain: "stripe.com", _apiKey: "your-trykitt-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your TryKitt API key (get one at trykitt.ai).

domain.description: Company domain or website, e.g. "stripe.com" or "https://stripe.com".

full_name.description: Full name as it appears on LinkedIn or similar, e.g. "Patrick Collison".

linkedin_url.description: Optional LinkedIn profile URL to disambiguate the person.

name: trykitt_find_email
title: Trykitt Find Email
